description_en: Deletes a shard or mongos node from an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 删除MongoDB分片集群实例中的Shard节点或Mongos节点
kebab_example: aliyun dds delete-node --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id s-bpxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shard or mongos node that you want to delete. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61923.html operation to query node IDs
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的Shard节点ID或Mongos节点ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61923.html接口查询节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the generated token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
